result.notes:
Маркетплейс и Codex-индекс собираются из unit.json. Новый aicore.content.marketplace (assemble, build --check, дубликаты → MARKETPLACE_DUPLICATE) и схема plugin-catalog/v1; контракт объявлен в aicore/unit.json; CLI `aicore marketplace build --hub ROOT [--check]`. skiller пишет packages/skiller/.claude-plugin/catalog.json и вызывает assemble; unit.json skiller объявляет catalog. planner объявляет planner и алиас task (source aliases/task); analyst, brain, harness и maind уже объявляли свои плагины. plugin_dirs не тронут (нужен module_skills.py). В этой сессии: в scripts/ecosystem-units.py (_check_paths) добавлена обработка provides.plugins с source/catalog вместо обязательного manifest, иначе V4 падал с KeyError (раньше это был блокер за пределами write_set). Байты против HEAD: .agents/plugins/marketplace.json идентичен; .claude-plugin/marketplace.json отличается одной строкой: package записи task теперь planner (было task). Golden skiller-registry перезахвачен с этой причиной. Тесты: test_marketplace (aicore, 13), skiller test_marketplace_catalog, test_bucket_alias, test_publication, test_host_publication, test_codex_publication, test_provider_publication_parity, scripts/test-ecosystem-units.py (148) — все OK; aicore schema compat: 0 errors, 1 warning (oneOf у provides.plugins.items), 4 notes.

deviations: scripts/ecosystem-units.py (_check_paths) read plugin['manifest'] unconditionally, so any provides.plugins entry with `source` or `catalog` (allowed by unit/v1 since P12.1) crashed `ecosystem-units.py check`. Fixed in this session: for `source` it probes <source>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, for `catalog` the catalog file; the manifest-name check is skipped for both. scripts/test-ecosystem-units.py (148 tests) passes, but I added no test for the new branch because the test file is outside write_set.

configs/umbrella.json has no `marketplace` key (the design takes owner/name from it). assemble() resolves name/owner as: explicit arguments, then configs/umbrella.json#marketplace if present, then a top-level `marketplace` {name, owner} block of a plugin-catalog. skiller's catalog.json carries that block, so the CLI --check reproduces the bytes without configs.

plugin-catalog/v1 differs from the knowledge sketch: (1) the `codex` object accepts optional source, description, category, tags besides required install_policy/auth, because the Codex entries of core and skm differ from their Claude entries; (2) an optional top-level `marketplace` block; (3) skills[] paths are module-relative (assemble prefixes the module path) because skiller's boundary test K1 rejects 'packages/skiller' inside the module; source './' still means the hub root; (4) the document key is `schema`, as in the knowledge text, while other aicore contracts use `$schema`.

aicore.content may not import aicore.ext (layering test), so the CLI loads units with its own marketplace.discover() on top of aicore.config.units.unit_dirs instead of aicore.ext.units.discover_units. Semantics are the same (SKM_UNITS_PATH, first id wins). The CLI sets SKM_UNITS_PATH to <hub>/packages when unset, and its main() lives in marketplace.py because no other aicore file for it was in the write set.
